name: YouthBeat Media Careers and Pre-Apprentice Program
what_you_do: You can get free media training in classrooms and afterschool clubs. Advanced students can join a pre-apprentice program and fee-for-service projects at YouthBeat PRO.
who_can_apply: OUSD high school students can apply to after school classes. Partner middle and high schools host classes on site. The pre-apprentice program is for rising 11th or 12th graders with a 2.0 GPA. The City summer jobs list shows Media Careers for ages 16 to 21 (June to September).
pay_detail: After school classes are free and pay a stipend of $300 to $600 per semester, based on attendance. The 2026-27 pre-apprentice program pays a $6,000 stipend. YouthBeat PRO pay rate not posted.
deadline_text: After school classes for 2026-27 are accepting applications as of Nov 2, 2026. No closing date is posted. The pre-apprentice form is closed. That program runs Sept 28, 2026 to March 24, 2027. Summer 2026 is closed.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply page at youthbeat.org/apply, or call 510-922-0060 or email youthbeatmedia@gmail.com.
notes: The summer ages 16 to 21 come from the City of Oakland's list. The pre-apprentice page lists ages 16 to 24. Address is a PO box in Oakland.
